name: Minterest mUSDY flashLoan exchange-rate reentrancy
summary: The Mantle mUSDY market's lendRUSDY lacked the nonReentrant guard of lend(). Inside mUSDY's own flashLoan callback, with the loaned cash out and the exchange rate depressed, the attacker supplied via lendRUSDY to mint excess mUSDY and redeemed, 25 times, then borrowed the WETH and mETH markets against the unbacked collateral.
notes: The upgrade in block 57147116 routed the market to the implementation carrying lendRUSDY; later supervisor changes (linkage root swap, collateral factors 0.4 to 0.8) and the oracle upgrade are not on the reentrancy path or only scale the loss. FlashLoanExecuted shows no other flash loan on mUSDY.

Loss is the net outflow of the three markets in the single exploit tx: WETH and mETH borrowed and never repaid, plus the USDY the mUSDY market lost to the attacker and its flash lender across the redeem cycles.
